company: Maîtrise d'Ouvrage de l'Aéroport de Donsin (MOAD)
card_says: The Burkinabe public body running the Donsin airport works and the resettlement (present tense)
source_says: A decree adopted at the Council of Ministers of 18 June 2025 created the Societe des Aeroports du Faso (SAFA), a state company, which 'reprend les attributions de la Maitrise d'ouvrage de l'Aeroport de Donsin (MOAD)' and of the RACGAE and DAAN. MOAD held those functions at the time of the case; it does not now.

company: Committee for Roads of the Republic of Kazakhstan / KazAvtoZhol
card_says: KazAvtoZhol was 'set up in 2013 as a joint stock company under the Committee for Roads'; the Committee for Roads is the 'project implementing agency' for cases filed in 2010 and 2011
source_says: An AIIB project document states 'The RC was established in 2013 under the Ministry of Transport (MoT), together with QAJ.' If the Roads Committee in its present form also dates from 2013, the two statements on the card sit awkwardly together. A 2016 ministerial order names it the 'Roads Committee of the Ministry of Investments and Development', and its official site now heads itself as a committee of the Ministry of Transport, so the body has been reattached to several ministries. Flagged for checking, not a settled correction.

company: Administracion de Aeropuertos y Servicios Auxiliares a la Navegacion Aerea (AASANA)
card_says: dissolved by the government on 1 December 2021
source_says: The dissolving instrument is Supreme Decree 4630 of 30 November 2021, which orders AASANA's cessation of operations, suppression and liquidation 'effective from publication'. The card's 1 December 2021 is consistent with publication the next day; the decree's own date is 30 November 2021.
